title: Wire 4-Way Consensus Into Dispatcher Decision Points
brief: Take the just-restored MultiModelConsensusEngine + CodexClient + GeminiClient + OllamaClient (smoke-tested 3-of-3 unanimous on 12+8=20) and wire them into the actual dispatcher action 'prism_ai:consensus_decide'. Make consensus the default path for high-stakes decisions (machine select, toolpath strategy, post-processor pick, speed/feed cap). Output: any caller can invoke prism_ai:consensus_decide with a question + options + agreement threshold and get a vote with provenance audit.

units.title: Add consensus_decide action to prism_ai dispatcher with Zod schema
exit_conditions: prism_ai dispatcher exposes 'consensus_decide' action
Zod schema validates {question, options[], voices[], agreementThreshold, sandboxBudget}
Action enum updated and indexed in dispatcher_map_compact
Tests: schema validation happy + 3 failure paths (empty options, NaN threshold, voices subset)
Typecheck clean: npx tsc --noEmit
units.description: Add the new action surface so callers (other dispatchers, hooks, CLI) can request a consensus decision. Schema must enforce ≥2 voices, threshold in [0,1], options length ≥2. Lazy-import MultiModelConsensusEngine. Reuse existing dispatcher patterns from prism_ai.

units.title: Implement consensus orchestration in MultiModelConsensusEngine.vote()
exit_conditions: MultiModelConsensusEngine.vote(question, options, voices) parallel-fanouts to Codex+Gemini+Ollama+optional Grok
Each voice's response normalized via comparator (numeric extraction or canonical-token match)
Result includes per-voice {answer, latencyMs, tokens, error}, top-vote count, provenance
Timeout: 60s default, configurable per call
Tests: 3-voice unanimous; 2-of-3 majority; voices_disagreement = no-consensus; 1 voice errors → continue; all voices error → return failure not throw
units.description: Engine orchestrates parallel calls via existing CodexClientEngine, GeminiClientEngine (REST or CLI based on auth), OllamaClientEngine. Use Promise.allSettled for graceful failures. Comparator pattern: numeric (regex first signed digit), token (first canonical word), or custom (caller-provided). All inputs validated.

units.title: Wire ConsensusCoordinatorEngine for retry + escalation policy
exit_conditions: ConsensusCoordinatorEngine.run() handles retry on ambiguous result (1-of-3 or split)
Escalates to higher-effort voices (Codex xhigh) when threshold not met after 1 retry
Returns 'human_review_required' when all retries fail
Tests: ambiguous → retry; ambiguous twice → escalate; escalate fails → human_review
units.description: Coordinator wraps the engine with policy logic. Use TaskClassifierEngine.shouldEscalate() to decide when to bump model effort. Track retry count in result audit.

units.title: Provenance audit log + persistence to consensus-decisions.jsonl
exit_conditions: Every consensus call appends one JSONL line to mcp-server/data/state/consensus-decisions.jsonl
Audit fields: ts, callerEngine, question, voices, perVoiceAnswers, finalDecision, agreement, latencyMsTotal, tokensTotal
schemaVersion field enforced; rotation at 100MB
Tests: 100 sequential calls produce 100 valid JSONL lines, parse round-trip clean
units.description: Atomic-write append. Reuse atomicWrite util. Add a dispatcher action 'consensus_audit_query' to read recent decisions for debugging.

units.title: End-to-end test: 3 decision types route through consensus_decide
exit_conditions: Test 1: machine_select decision (mill 3-axis vs 5-axis) → consensus_decide returns 4-of-4 expected answer
Test 2: post-processor pick (Hurco V11 vs Okuma OSP) → consensus_decide returns ≥3-of-4 expected answer
Test 3: speed/feed adjustment (high vs low) → consensus_decide returns expected with agreement >= 0.75
Audit log shows 3 entries with full provenance
Wall time per call ≤ 60s (Codex bound)
units.description: Real network calls (not mocks) to validate end-to-end. If Codex hangs >60s, fall back to 3-voice (skip Codex) and assert majority. Document latency p50/p99 for each voice in test output.

acceptance: prism_ai:consensus_decide action live; 3 decision types pass with documented agreement+latency; consensus-decisions.jsonl audit log present and parseable; smoke test reproducible.
